description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect" processRef="Process_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements"
                      name="Send requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements"
                      targetRef="Start_Architect_Initial"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements"
                      name="Send additional requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"
                      targetRef="Start_Architect_Additional"
                      messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>

                      name="Return draft"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDraft"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraft"
                      name="Return revised draft"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MaterialsOrder"
                      name="Order materials"
                      sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials"
                      targetRef="Participant_Stores"
                      messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderProcessed"
                      name="Order processed"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Stores"
                      targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"
                      messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest"
                      name="Message friends to build the house"
                      sourceRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild"
                      targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>

                      name="Send party invitations"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations"
                      targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildingHouse" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_BuildingHouse">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BuildingHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefinementDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefineDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAdditionalRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MessageFriendsToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BuildingHouse" name="Want to build a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementDecision" name="Is further refinement needed?" default="Flow_PlanReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from architect" messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create categorized materials list from plan"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from several online stores" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Wait for order processing while messaging friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" name="Message friends to build the house" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Order processed and friends messaged"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of party attendees"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AttendeeListCreated" name="Party attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_BuildingHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_SendRequirements" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDraft_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NeedsRefinement" name="Further refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreRequirementsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanReady" name="Plan ready" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_SendAdditional" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveRevised" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveRevised_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_OrderProcessed" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_MessageFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderProcessed_Join" sourceRef="Event_OrderProcessed" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MessageFriends_Join" sourceRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Invitations" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Architect prepares tree house drafts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Architect_Initial" name="Receive initial requirements">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateDraft" name="Create tree house draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft to you" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Architect_DraftSent" name="Draft sent"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Architect_Additional" name="Receive additional requirements">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateRevisedDraft" name="Create revised tree house draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedDraft" name="Send revised draft to you" messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Architect_RevisedDraftSent" name="Revised draft sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Initial_Create" sourceRef="Start_Architect_Initial" targetRef="Task_CreateDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Create_Send" sourceRef="Task_CreateDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Send_End" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="End_Architect_DraftSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Additional_Create" sourceRef="Start_Architect_Additional" targetRef="Task_CreateRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Revised_Send" sourceRef="Task_CreateRevisedDraft" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Revised_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft" targetRef="End_Architect_RevisedDraftSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
